facts.text: RealEnv documents a flat action of six left-arm joint positions, one normalized left-gripper position (0 close, 1 open), six right-arm joint positions and one normalized right-gripper position (0 close, 1 open).

RealEnv.step splits the flat action in half, sends the first six values of each half to the left and right arm set_joint_positions, sends the last value of each half to set_gripper_pose, sleeps DT and returns a dm_env TimeStep.

RealEnv.get_qpos reads six arm positions from each recorder, normalizes the measured gripper position at recorder index 7, and returns left arm, left gripper, right arm and right gripper in that order.
RealEnv.get_qvel and get_effort read the same recorder streams; qvel takes six arm values and the normalized gripper velocity, and get_effort returns the first seven values per side.
RealEnv.get_images returns the ImageRecorder's camera image dictionary.
The README says the launch starts communication with 4 robots and 4 cameras.
The launch file starts usb_cam nodes with image_width 640, image_height 480 and framerate 60.
RealEnv.set_gripper_pose converts each normalized value with PUPPET_GRIPPER_JOINT_UNNORMALIZE_FN and publishes a JointSingleCommand on each puppet.
PUPPET_GRIPPER_POSITION_OPEN is 0.05800 and PUPPET_GRIPPER_POSITION_CLOSE is 0.01844 in the left-finger position constants; the cited lines do not state a unit.
PUPPET_GRIPPER_POSITION_NORMALIZE_FN maps a measured gripper position to (x - close) / (open - close).
RealEnv.reset reboots both gripper motors, moves both arms to START_ARM_POSE, and opens then closes both grippers when fake is false.
RealEnv constructs both puppet arms as InterbotixManipulatorXS robot_model vx300s with group arm and gripper gripper.
The puppet mode configs enable torque and set the arm group to position control and the gripper single to linear_position control.

The Recorder subscribes to /puppet_<side>/joint_states as sensor_msgs/JointState and to /puppet_<side>/commands/joint_group and /puppet_<side>/commands/joint_single as interbotix_xs_msgs JointGroupCommand and JointSingleCommand.
The launch file defaults robot_model_master to wx250s and robot_model_puppet to vx300s.
The launch file includes interbotix_xsarm_control for each master and puppet arm.
The README warns that the robot will collapse if motors are torque off because the joints have no automatically engaged brakes.
The README instructs lowering the robots with sleep.py before cutting off power.
